risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Revenue is heavily concentrated in nutraceuticals with a limited client base, per the MD&A Risk and Concerns section.
- The Company faces competition and pricing pressure as the CDMO market is fragmented.
- Management flags margin volatility arising from raw-material costs, supply-chain disruption and foreign-exchange movements.
- The Company's products are subject to evolving regulatory regimes (FSSAI, AYUSH, US FDA), creating compliance risk.
- Management explicitly flags execution risk tied to ongoing capacity expansion, automation initiatives and ESG compliance.
- Could pose a challenge to sales growth, especially in new geographic regions, per the Opportunities and Threats section.
- Delays in implementation of government schemes/regulations could affect timely release of new products in segments such as veterinary feeds.
- Challenges the Company's ability to innovate and maintain high operational standards, potentially slowing product development and growth.
